name: Adjourned Regular Investment Advisory Committee Meeting
agenda_text:
ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING AGENDA

  CITY OF LA HABRA HEIGHTS
  INVESTMENT ADVISORY COMMITTEE

  1245 N. Hacienda Road
  La Habra Heights, California 90631

  3:00 p.m. Regular Business

  January 23, 2019
The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you
require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s
office at (562) 694-6302.

Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Investment Advisory Committee
after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection with the City Clerk at
1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.

PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
Each member of the public may speak for a total of five minutes on any action item listed on
the agenda or other matters within the Investment Advisory Committee’s purview. In addition,
each member of the public may also speak during the second Public Comment segment for no
more than one minute concerning matters not on the agenda. To speak in the Public Comment
segment please complete and deliver a speaker’s card to the Clerk prior to the call for public
comments. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak. Be advised
that the Chair may limit speaking time at his discretion.

Should you need to provide written documentation, please give the Clerk a minimum of NINE
(9) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed to the
Committee.

OPENING CEREMONIES

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

2.  ROLL CALL: Chair David Little, Vice-Chair William Herzog, Council Member Brian
  Bergman, Member Dinesh Ghiya, Council Member Carey Klingfus, and City Treasurer Don
  Tilley
ADJOURNED REGULAR INVESTMENT ADVISORY COMMITTEE MEETING AGENDA  JANUARY 23, 2019
 3.  PUBLIC COMMENT

COMMITTEE BUSINESS

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES – OCTOBER 17, 2018

  RECOMMENDATION:  Approve.

5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES – NOVEMBER 28, 2018

  RECOMMENDATION:  Approve.

6.  REVIEW AND DISCUSS INVESTMENTS

  RECOMMENDATION:  Review, discuss and provide direction to the City
  Treasurer.

  -------------------------------- END OF ADMINISTRATIVE ITEMS --------------------------------

7.  PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA (ONE MINUTE)

ADJOURN MEETING
UPON ADJOURNMENT OF THE MEETING, PLEASE LEAVE THE ROOM PROMPTLY AND
TAKE YOUR PERSONAL BELONGINGS WITH YOU TO ALLOW STAFF TO CLEAN UP AND
CLOSE THE BUILDING. IF YOU ARE RECORDING, PLEASE NOTE THAT THE
CONVERSATIONS THAT TAKE PLACE FROM THIS POINT FORWARD MAY BE PRIVATE,
ARE NOT PART OF THE PUBLIC MEETING, AND CONSENT OF ALL PARTIES TO THE
CONVERSATION MAY BE REQUIRED PRIOR TO RECORDING.

ADJOURNED REGULAR INVESTMENT ADVISORY COMMITTEE MEETING AGENDA  JANUARY 23, 2019
